summary.text: John McGuire is the Republican incumbent U.S. Representative for Virginia's 5th District, first elected in 2024 after defeating then-Rep. Bob Good in the Republican primary. A former Navy SEAL who founded a fitness-training business, he served in the Virginia House of Delegates from 2018 and briefly in the Virginia Senate before going to Congress. He serves on the Armed Services and Oversight committees and is seeking a second term.

paragraphs.text: McGuire was born in Richmond, Virginia, in 1968 and graduated from Henrico High School. His official biography says he was raised in Central Virginia, spent part of his early childhood in the foster care system, and was raised by his grandparents.
He served as a U.S. Navy SEAL from 1988 to 1998; his official biography says he was a sniper and sniper instructor.

After leaving the military, he founded SEAL Team Physical Training Inc. (SEAL Team PT), a fitness-training business that, according to his official biography, has trained individuals, companies and sports teams.
McGuire was elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in 2018 and represented District 56 until 2024.

He won the Republican convention in May 2023 and the November 2023 general election for Virginia Senate District 10, and served in the Senate in 2024. His official biography lists service on the Local Government, Privileges and Elections, and Transportation committees and says he led bills on naloxone in schools and on taxes on veteran retirement pay.

McGuire defeated incumbent Rep. Bob Good in the June 18, 2024 Republican primary, 50.3% to 49.7%, with an endorsement from Donald Trump, and won the November 2024 general election by about 15 percentage points over Democrat Gloria Tinsley Witt.
He took office in January 2025 and in the 119th Congress serves on the House Armed Services Committee and the House Oversight Committee.
According to his official biography, he lives in Goochland, Virginia, with his wife, Tracy; they have raised five children.
